description: Per-GPU hourly rental prices used for the cost columns in README.md. Median on-demand price per GPU-hour across providers as aggregated by GetDeploying, read on the retrieval date below. These are market snapshots, not our rental invoices; the measured whole-node charges remain in affordable-video-768-results.json.
formula: usd_per_clip = usd_per_gpu_hour * gpus_used * mean_seconds / 3600; usd_per_video_second = usd_per_clip / clip_seconds (short 124/24 s, long 345/24 s). GPU rental only, at full utilization; loading, warmup, idle time, storage and bandwidth are excluded.

rtx_pro5000_blackwell.basis: cheapest in-stock on-demand; no median published (4 providers)

b300.note: median across the 16 providers with priced on-demand B300 configurations (33 tracked); page last updated 2026-09-16
